basics.name: Tuan Doan
basics.summary: Machine Learning Engineer with 5+ years of experience building and deploying computer vision and LLM-powered systems. Specialized in RAG pipelines, document intelligence, and OCR.

highlights: LLM & RAG Systems: Projects include HR-Chatbot, Codebase-Chatbot, Terminal-Chatbot, and Document Q&A systems. Focus on Retrieval part in RAG technique: parsing, chunking, indexing, retrieval. Design and implement Document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, enabling enterprise RAG systems. Build multi-tenant indexing and retrieval system with duplicate prevention, custom chunking, and hybrid retrieval + reranking.
Document Intelligence: Built pipelines to classify shipping documents and extract key-value pairs and bounding boxes, supporting downstream automation workflows.

Container Number Recognition: Improved system accuracy from 91% to 98.1% through data augmentation, model retraining, and post-processing optimization. Retrained text detection model using PaddleOCR (v4) and MMOCR (DB++). Generated synthetic OCR training data for robustness under low-quality conditions.
Robotics: Integrated Speech-to-text, Text-to-speech services, and OCR into Robotic system. Retrained object detection models using YOLOv8 for real-time perception tasks.
MLOps: Implemented Azure-based ML workflows covering experiment tracking, model versioning, and deployment pipelines.
Adult Content Detection in Videos: Trained adult content detection model for large-scale video moderation, outperforming legacy model in precision and recall for production censorship systems.
